bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
cd /home/admin1/projects/ai-core/models
file=Qwen3.5-4B-Q4_K_M.gguf
part="$file.part"
sha=217002fa8008ef4fc6d548353a3aebef055a96e6ff8e0e2c0953ef8254a89c14
if [ -f "$file" ]; then printf '%s  %s\n' "$sha" "$file" | sha256sum -c -; exit 0; fi
test ! -L "$part"
avail=$(df -B1 --output=avail . | tail -1)
test "$avail" -gt 53030000000
rc=0
curl --fail --location --silent --show-error --connect-timeout 15 --max-time 65 --continue-at - --output "$part" https://huggingface.co/ggml-org/Qwen3.5-4B-GGUF/resolve/main/Qwen3.5-4B-Q4_K_M.gguf || rc=$?
if [ "$rc" -ne 0 ]; then printf 'DOWNLOAD_PARTIAL bytes='; stat -c %s "$part" 2>/dev/null || true; exit "$rc"; fi
printf '%s  %s\n' "$sha" "$part" | sha256sum -c -
test ! -e "$file"
mv -n "$part" "$file"
printf 'VERIFIED_MODEL '; stat -c '%n %s' "$file"
